name: Early Training Evaluation Benchmarks for SLMs
description: Evaluate Small Language Models (SLMs) during early training stages on scientific knowledge acquisition, reasoning, and sensitivity to knowledge-intensive tasks.

cr:input.name: Input Dataset
cr:input.description: Input dataset contains a single column 'id' with unique sample identifiers. Example values: 'sample_000', 'sample_001', 'sample_002'.
cr:input.contentUrl: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset source URL]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Predictions are expected in a CSV file with two columns: 'id' (matching input IDs) and 'pred' (predicted values). Example values for 'pred': 0.6470268045601905, 0.35506678184339246.

field.name: id
field.description: Unique identifier for each sample. Example values: 'sample_000', 'sample_001'.

field.name: pred
field.description: Predicted value for the sample. Example values: 0.6470268045601905, 0.35506678184339246.

cr:evaluation.notes: Metrics are computed using Spearman correlation, mean squared error, and other statistical methods. Total Score is a weighted combination of Signal Quality (0.5), Ranking Consistency (0.1), and Compliance Score (0.4).
